title: Gut dysbiosis, metabolic signals, and pulmonary immune reprogramming: decoding the gut microbiota -immune axis in stroke-associated pneumonia.
snippet: Stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) is the most common infectious complication following acute stroke.
